title: R2 Handoff 1 — explicit learnit.kit.v5 contract, schema and deterministic validator
purpose: Execute only R2 Handoff 1: materialize and qualify an explicit closed learnit.kit.v5 successor contract plus deterministic V5 validator while proving frozen learnit.kit.v4 remains unchanged.
invariants: learnit.kit.v4 schema, validator and validator tests remain byte-identical to the common base.
V4 and V5 are explicit discriminator-separated contracts with no automatic conversion.
V5 activity-family schemas remain closed while adding only optional hints[] and references[] through shared activity definitions.
hints[] and references[] are canonical authored content and participate in activity, course and package digest identity.
V5 reuses V4 asset/media semantics; references never become remote media.
Reference validation is deterministic and static only; Handoff 1 performs no network link-health checks.
No runtime/UI, Atlas assistance, Authoring/Factory/source governance, V8, 10C port/review, WP-054 preparation, merge, cherry-pick, promotion or student session is authorized.
requiredEvidence: Fresh HCP binding and exact common-base revalidation before mutation.
Exact V4 schema/validator/test blob immutability proof on candidate head.
Narrow V5 deterministic unit/adversarial tests on exact candidate head.
Every activity family accepts bounded hints[] and references[] in V5.
V4 rejects V5 discriminator and V5-only fields; V5 rejects V4 discriminator.
Reference objects are closed and reject unsafe/non-HTTPS/malformed forms without network I/O.
Existing V4 remote-media and SVG fail-closed semantics remain effective in V5.
Hint/reference mutations and hint ordering change the canonical digest chain deterministically.
Changed-path scope is limited to this work package's allowed paths.
Repository governance evidence is collected on the exact candidate head when available.
PR #441 remains DRAFT, OPEN and UNMERGED.
adversarialTests: Four hints must fail while zero through three hints remain structurally admissible.
Empty or whitespace-only hints must fail.
References missing url, label or hook, carrying extra provenance fields, or shaped as media must fail.
http, javascript, file, blob, protocol-relative, malformed, credential-bearing and backslash URLs must fail.
Unknown V5 activity fields must fail closed.
Remote media and unsafe SVG must remain rejected by inherited V4 semantics.
Changing reference url, label or hook must change the activity/course/package digest chain.
Reordering hints must change digest identity while unchanged revalidation is deterministic.
No local PASS may override repository-governance failure.
nonGoals: Atlas hint implementation or assistance behavior.
Authoring Skill, Factory or source-governance implementation.
10C showcase port or independent semantic review.
Merge, cherry-pick, promotion or student session.
independentReview: Final audit independently rechecks V4 immutability, V4/V5 separation, digest participation and exact changed paths after build.
Repository governance is treated as an independent exact-head check and cannot be overridden by local unit tests.
Any material decision outside the frozen R2 record stops at HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED instead of expanding scope.
rollback: If Handoff 1 is rejected or abandoned, close draft PR #441 and delete branch student-v01/r2-v5-contract-r1; common base student-v01/fanin-b@18b925436777943b19c4b031c24659ad60dee133 and frozen V4 blobs remain unchanged.
